text: Your dog just ate chocolate. Here's what you do.
Chocolate has a chemical called theobromine, and a dog's body gets rid of it really slowly.
It makes his heart race. He can start shaking, throwing up, and even have seizures.
But signs usually take six to twelve hours to show, so he might look totally fine at first.
Dark and baking chocolate are the worst. Milk chocolate is weaker, and white chocolate barely has any.
For a big golden retriever, about one large dark chocolate bar can make him sick.
So grab the wrapper and call your vet or animal poison control right away.
Don't make him throw up on your own. The vet will tell you if you should.
And watch out this week. Around Halloween, chocolate tops the list of pet poison calls.
And that's what to do if your dog eats chocolate.
